messages:
linh: Heads-up — product wants to change the rerank endpoint score envelope to include a per-candidate cost_estimate and model_hint field. This impacts quota billing and console UX for per-tenant cost visibility.
aj: Can you paste the proposed shape? is this additive only or replacing existing score field?
maria: Additive only. current plan: keep score, add metadata object. prod wants cost_estimate so customers can show token-cost per candidate in their UI.
linh: Proposed example:
```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1","score":0.82,"meta":{"model_hint":"rwk-7b-q4","cost_estimate":0.00012}},
    {"id":"c2","score":0.79,"meta":{"model_hint":"rwk-7b-q4","cost_estimate":0.00009}}
  ]
}
```
sam: OK but this affects quota accounting. We bill per-token/model. cost_estimate is derived client-side or server-side? if server, we need to attach cost-unit tagging for billing pipeline.
maria: Server-side. We want a best-effort estimate. Not legal for billing but for visibility. Should be flagged as estimate.
rajesh: Telemetry concern: adding per-candidate fields will balloon logs and metric tags. We can't add model_hint as a high-cardinality tag in the main metrics pipeline.
aj: Agree. We should emit model_hint only to trace/span or optional debug logs, not primary metrics. For console, show aggregated breakdowns (top models used, p95 cost per tenant) rather than tagging every request.
linh: UX ask: product wants a console toggle to "show per-candidate cost" and a rollout knob for "model_hint exposure" at tenant level (off by default).
console-bot: Suggestion: Add a per-tenant feature-flag that controls whether cost_estimate and model_hint are returned in responses. Default OFF for all existing customers; opt-in for new feature.
sam: From an infra side, if we return extra fields, payload sizes increase. Need to understand tail latency impact with large candidate lists (k=200).
maria: We should enforce a response size cap or sampling when k>50 for cost_estimate fields. Maybe only include meta for top-20 candidates by default.
aj: Implementation plan:
- Server: always compute estimates but only attach to response when tenant flag ON or when ?expose_meta=true header.
- Console: feature flag toggle + rollout UI (canary to subset of tenants)
- Metrics: emit aggregate metrics: rerank.cost.estimate.sum, rerank.cost.estimate.p95 per-tenant, no per-candidate tags.
rajesh: Also we need a migration plan for quota/billing: existing billing remains unchanged. Add a new telemetry pipeline that maps cost_estimate->internal cost_units for reporting. Mark estimates as non-billable in invoice generation.
linh: What about routing? product expects the model_hint so app can prefer lower-cost models client-side. But we also have smart routing that selects cheaper variants automatically. Potentially duplicate logic.
sam: We should keep smart routing server-side and add a signal in the response that indicates whether the server actually used a cheaper fallback (e.g., routing_decision: "selected_variant: rwk-7b-q4, reason: cost_threshold"). That keeps clients informed without exposing internal routing policy.
maria: Good idea. Add ephemeral routing metadata separate from candidate meta. e.g.
```json
{"routing": {"selected_variant":"rwk-7b-q4","decision_tags":["cost_savings"]}}
```
aj: Telemetry naming: prefer rerank.routing.selected_variant and rerank.routing.reason as event attributes, but don't add as high-cardinality metrics.
rajesh: For rollout: propose 3-phase plan
1) Internal opt-in for dev tenants + smoke tests (2 weeks)
2) Canary with ~5% of production tenants, console toggle visible (2 weeks)
3) Broad opt-in + deprecation schedule for old parity (announce 60 days)
linh: Who owns the console toggle implementation? product or eng-platform?
maria: eng-platform implements backend flag and API; product + devex will wire the console control. eng-platform must provide an API for listing tenants and flag states + audit logs.
console-bot: Also require an audit trail event: feature_flag.toggled {tenant, actor, ts}.ops-bot: SLO consideration: if we add optional compute (estimates) it could increase p95. We should gate heavy compute behind sampling and a tenant-level budget.
sam: We can compute cost_estimate cheaply (based on token len * model unit cost), it's O(1) per candidate, but for large fanout it's still linear. Suggest default limit: attach meta for up to 20 candidates; beyond that include a sampled subset header: X-Rerank-Sampled-Meta: 20/200.
aj: API change checklist:
- new optional response field: candidates[].meta.{model_hint,cost_estimate}
- new optional response field: routing
- header for forcing meta: X-Rerank-Expose-Meta
- tenant feature flag: rerank.meta.expose
- console toggle + rollout controls + audit events
- telemetry: aggregate metrics only + new event for routing variant
maria: Docs: need clear "non-billable estimate" language, and example console screenshots for rollout controls.
linh: Compatibility: add a request param `compat=v2` for apps that want to opt-in immediately. Default behavior: compat=v1 (no meta). Deprecation path: 6 months notice.
rajesh: Ops: add a rate-limit policy for metadata-heavy responses: if tenant exceeds 1M meta-candidates/day, auto-disable meta and send alert.
sam: Can we add a console alerting card for tenants nearing the meta budget? yes, add to console: tenant >75% of meta budget -> banner.
aj: I'm fine with this. I'll draft the PR for the API contract and the metrics spec. Who wants to own the rollout playbook?
maria: I'll own the playbook with eng-platform help. I'll put a draft in the product-runbook channel.
linh: Great. Action items:
- aj: API proto + sample responses + feature flag API (ETA 3d)
- sam: perf test for k up to 200 with meta on/off (ETA 5d)
- rajesh: metric and logging plan + budget enforcement rule (ETA 4d)
- maria: docs + console mockups + rollout playbook (ETA 1w)
- linh: coordinate release announcement and deprecation message (ETA 1w)
maria: sgtm :thumbsup:
aj: lgtm
sam: will run perf tests
rajesh: will add budget alert
console-bot: Noted — I'll create the feature-flag scaffold in the console repo and add audit events when toggled.
